title: Parity complexes redux
summary: We fix the notion of parity complex by a judicious selection from among the axioms originally considered by Street. We show that parity complexes so defined, together with the morphisms of parity complexes defined by Verity, form a category equivalent to the category of strong Steiner complexes (nés augmented directed complexes with strongly loop-free unital bases). To this end, we isolate the purely combinatorial structure possessed by the bases of free augmented directed complexes.
